Subject: Charge on INV-6912 — mid-cycle 8 → 12 GPU seats (Oct)

Hi Ben,

We just received invoice INV-6912 for October and it shows the full monthly charge for 12 seats, but we only added 4 seats on Oct 3rd. Our expectation was a prorated charge for 28 days at 8 seats and 3 days at 12 seats. The total on the invoice is significantly higher than what our finance team expected.

Can you confirm why the full month was billed? If this is an automated mid-cycle billing issue please correct and send a credit memo. We also need the VAT breakdown — our VAT ID is EU123456789 (attached).

Attached: INV-6912.pdf, VAT_ID_EU123456789.pdf

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Charge on INV-6912 — mid-cycle 8 → 12 GPU seats (Oct)

Ben / Karthik / Aisha — I pulled the invoice and usage. Summary of calculations below.

Timeline:
- Oct 1–Oct 2: 8 seats (2 days)
- Oct 3–Oct 31: 12 seats (29 days)
- Our monthly billing period: Oct 1–Oct 31 (31 days)

What was billed (INV-6912): 12 seats × full month = $14,400 (example numbers)
What should be billed (prorated): (8 seats × 2/31 + 12 seats × 29/31) × seat_rate = $???. I ran a provisional calc below and produced a credit.

Provisional numbers (seat_rate = $1000/month per seat):
- Billed: 12 × $1000 = $12,000
- Correct: (8 × 2/31 + 12 × 29/31) × $1000 = (16/31 + 348/31) × $1000 = (364/31) × $1000 = $11,741.94
- Credit to issue: $12,000 - $11,741.94 = $258.06

VAT handling: Because Juniper provided an EU VAT ID and the service export rules apply, VAT was recorded but should be zero-rated on our side (we need to confirm with tax team). Karthik, please confirm whether the credit memo should include the VAT reversal or if we issue a net credit and handle VAT via a separate tax adjustment.

Next steps proposed:
1) Issue provisional credit memo for $258.06 and send corrected invoice (INV-6912-C) to Aisha.
2) Karthik to confirm VAT steps (refund vs. tax reversal).
3) Once Juniper signs the amendment (DocuSign) acknowledging the seat addition date, we finalize. I attached a provisional credit memo (PDF) and a DocuSign link placeholder for the amendment.

Attachments: provisional_credit_77821.pdf; amendment_docusign_link.txt

Monica Patel
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Monica prepared a provisional credit of $258.06 based on our internal seat rate. We will issue a corrected invoice (INV-6912-C) showing the prorated charge and attach the credit memo. Karthik is confirming tax/VAT reversal; if VAT needs a separate filing we will include instructions for your finance team.

Please confirm receipt and if the Oct 3 seat addition date is correct. If you confirm, I’ll have Monica issue the credit and send the corrected invoice today and share the DocuSign amendment link so your legal/finance can sign to formalize the mid-cycle seat increase.
